newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CWM Mortgage started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CWM Mortgage started.

text.p: -- UBS Securities Equity Research Gareth Plank said he initiated coverage of CWM Mortgage Holdings Inc with a buy rating and a 12-14 month target price of $24.
-- "CWM is uniquely positioned to benefit from the continued consolidation of the financial services industry," Plank said in a research note.

"The company's lack of federal regulation and strong entrepreneurial orientation should position it to continue exploiting consolidation of the mortgage market as well as introduce products and services to expanding markets on a timely basis."
